license_required.quote: Any person who practices medicine without first having obtained a license shall be deemed to have violated this article.

issuing_authority.quote: A board is established to be known as the Georgia Composite Medical Board.

name.quote: A board is established to be known as the Georgia Composite Medical Board.

type.quote: A board is established to be known as the Georgia Composite Medical Board. The board shall be composed of 15 members

umbrella_agency.quote: The board shall not be under the jurisdiction of the Secretary of State but shall be an independent state agency attached to the Department of Community Health for administrative purposes only

moral_character_required.quote: All applicants for a license to practice medicine or for a renewal of any such license which has been revoked shall furnish the board with evidence of good moral character.

degree_required.value: Applications from candidates to practice medicine or surgery in any of its branches shall be accompanied by proof that the applicant is a graduate of some legally incorporated medical school or osteopathic medical school.
degree_required.quote: Applications from candidates to practice medicine or surgery in any of its branches shall be accompanied by proof that the applicant is a graduate of some legally incorporated medical school or osteopathic medical school.

accrediting_body.value: board-approved medical school or osteopathic medical school
accrediting_body.quote: The board by rule or regulation may establish standards for evaluating, inspecting, and approving any medical school or osteopathic medical school.

degree_level.quote: Applications from candidates to practice medicine or surgery in any of its branches shall be accompanied by proof that the applicant is a graduate of some legally incorporated medical school or osteopathic medical school.

school_approval_basis.quote: The board by rule or regulation may establish standards for evaluating, inspecting, and approving any medical school or osteopathic medical school. The evaluation procedure may include consideration of reports from any outside agency having expertise in medical school or osteopathic medical school evaluation; provided, however, that the board shall make the final decision on approval of medical schools and osteopathic medical schools.

credential_pegged.quote: Applications from candidates to practice medicine or surgery in any of its branches shall be accompanied by proof that the applicant is a graduate of some legally incorporated medical school or osteopathic medical school.

required.quote: Graduates of board approved medical schools or osteopathic medical schools and persons who graduated on or before July 1, 1985, from medical schools or osteopathic medical schools which are not approved by the board must complete one year of a postgraduate residency training program.

experience_source.quote: Graduates of board approved medical schools or osteopathic medical schools and persons who graduated on or before July 1, 1985, from medical schools or osteopathic medical schools which are not approved by the board must complete one year of a postgraduate residency training program.

duration.value: one year (standard graduates); three years (non-approved school graduates after July 1, 1985)
duration.quote: Graduates of board approved medical schools or osteopathic medical schools and persons who graduated on or before July 1, 1985, from medical schools or osteopathic medical schools which are not approved by the board must complete one year of a postgraduate residency training program. Persons who graduated after July 1, 1985, from medical schools or osteopathic medical schools which are not approved by the board must complete three years of residency, fellowship, or other postgraduate medical training

kind.quote: Graduates of board approved medical schools or osteopathic medical schools and persons who graduated on or before July 1, 1985, from medical schools or osteopathic medical schools which are not approved by the board must complete one year of a postgraduate residency training program.

exams.name: Board-approved licensing examination
exams.notes: The board may approve any examination or examinations that it deems must be passed in order to meet the requirements for licensure. Examinations shall be in English.
exams.quote: The board may approve any examination or examinations that it deems must be passed in order to meet the requirements for licensure. Such examinations shall be in English.

exams.name: USMLE or COMLEX-USA
exams.notes: Required for IMLC expedited license eligibility: passed each component within three attempts.
exams.quote: Passed each component of the United States Medical Licensing Examination (USMLE) or the Comprehensive Osteopathic Medical Licensing Examination (COMLEX-USA) within three attempts

exams.name: Educational Council for Foreign Medical Graduates (ECFMG) qualifying examination
exams.notes: Required for foreign medical graduates seeking supervised clinical training pathway before ACGME graduate education.
exams.quote: shall pass the Educational Council for Foreign Medical Graduates (ECFMG) qualifying examination.

interval_years.quote: Licenses, certificates, and permits issued by the board shall be subject to renewal and shall be valid for up to two years unless otherwise specified by this chapter and shall be renewable biennially on the renewal date established by the board.

required.quote: The board shall be authorized to require persons seeking renewal of a license, certificate, or permit under this chapter to complete board approved continuing education of not less than 40 hours biennially.

hours_per_period.quote: complete board approved continuing education of not less than 40 hours biennially

period_years.quote: complete board approved continuing education of not less than 40 hours biennially

value: one-time minimum two hours on professional boundaries and physician sexual misconduct (on and after January 1, 2022)
topical_requirements.quote: On and after January 1, 2022, all physicians shall be required to receive one-time education and training, for a minimum of two hours, regarding professional boundaries and physician sexual misconduct.

available.quote: The board may grant a license without examination to licensees of boards of other states requiring equal or higher qualifications.

requirements.value: Board may grant license without examination to licensees of boards of other states requiring equal or higher qualifications. Expedited license also available via Interstate Medical Licensure Compact.
requirements.quote: The board may grant a license without examination to licensees of boards of other states requiring equal or higher qualifications. The board may grant an expedited license to licensees of boards of other states pursuant to the Interstate Medical Licensure Compact Act contained in Article 11 of this chapter.

exists.quote: A board is established to be known as the Georgia Composite Medical Board. The board shall be composed of 15 members

national_certification.quote: Current certification of any applicant by a member board of the American Board of Medical Specialties may be considered by the board as evidence that such applicant's postgraduate medical training has satisfied the requirements of this paragraph.

national_association.value: American Medical Association; American Osteopathic Association; National Medical Association
national_association.quote: The board shall be authorized to approve courses offered by institutions of higher learning, specialty societies, or professional organizations, including, but not limited to, the American Medical Association, the National Medical Association, and the American Osteopathic Association

regulatory_model.quote: Any person who wishes to obtain the right to practice medicine in this state ... shall obtain from the board a license to practice medicine. Any person who practices medicine without first having obtained a license shall be deemed to have violated this article.

credential_type.quote: shall obtain from the board a license to practice medicine

is_mandatory.quote: Any person who practices medicine without first having obtained a license shall be deemed to have violated this article.

title_protection.quote: shall attach the title "M.D.," "Oph.," "D.," "Dop.," "Surgeon," "Doctor," "D.O.," "Doctor of Osteopathy," "Osteopathic Physician," or "Physician," either alone or in connection with other words, or any other word or abbreviation to his or her name indicative that he or she is engaged in the treatment of diseased, defective, or injured human beings, and shall not in any of these cases then possess a valid license to practice medicine under the laws of this state, he or she shall be deemed to be practicing medicine without complying with this article

scope_protection.quote: If any person shall hold himself or herself out to the public as being engaged in the diagnosis or treatment of disease or injuries of human beings ... and shall not in any of these cases then possess a valid license to practice medicine under the laws of this state, he or she shall be deemed to be practicing medicine without complying with this article and shall be deemed in violation of this article.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to demonstrate the qualifications or standards for a license contained in the chapter or board rules
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failed to demonstrate the qualifications or standards for a license, certificate, or permit contained in this chapter or in the rules and regulations of the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly made misleading, deceptive, untrue, or fraudulent representations, or practiced fraud or deceit in obtaining a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly made misleading, deceptive, untrue, or fraudulent representations in the practice of a profession licensed, certified, or permitted under this chapter or in any document connected therewith; practiced fraud or deceit or intentionally made any false statement in obtaining a license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Convicted of a felony in the courts of this state or any other state, territory, country, or of the United States
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Been convicted of a felony in the courts of this state or any other state, territory, country, or of the United States.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committed a crime involving moral turpitude, without regard to conviction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committed a crime involving moral turpitude, without regard to conviction; the conviction of a crime involving moral turpitude shall be evidence of the commission of such crime.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Had license revoked, suspended, or annulled by any lawful licensing authority, or been denied a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Had his or her license, certificate, or permit to practice pursuant to this chapter revoked, suspended, or annulled by any lawful licensing authority; had other disciplinary action taken against him or her by any lawful licensing authority; or been denied a license by any lawful licensing authority

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertised for or solicited patients; obtained fee on representation that incurable disease can be permanently cured; or made untruthful or flamboyant claims
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertised for or solicited patients; obtained a fee or other thing of value on the representation that a manifestly incurable disease can be permanently cured; or made untruthful or improbable statements, or flamboyant or extravagant claims concerning his or her professional excellence or treatment protocols

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in any unprofessional, unethical, deceptive, or deleterious conduct or practice harmful to the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaged in any unprofessional, unethical, deceptive, or deleterious conduct or practice harmful to the public, which need not have resulted in actual injury to any person.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performed, procured, or aided or abetted in performing or procuring a criminal abortion
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performed, procured, or aided or abetted in performing or procuring a criminal abortion

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly aided unlicensed persons to practice, or divided fees for patient referrals
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly maintained a professional connection or association with any person who is in violation of this chapter or the rules or regulations of the board; knowingly aided, assisted, procured, or advised any person to practice pursuant to this chapter contrary to this chapter; or divided fees or agreed to divide fees received for professional services with any person, firm, association, corporation, or other entity for bringing or referring a patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated or attempted to violate a law, rule, or regulation regulating the practice of medicine, or violated a lawful order of the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violated or attempted to violate a law, rule, or regulation of this state, any other state, the board, the United States, or any other lawful authority without regard to whether the violation is criminally punishable, when such law, rule, or regulation relates to or in part regulates the practice of medicine

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committed any act or omission indicative of bad moral character or untrustworthiness
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committed any act or omission which is indicative of bad moral character or untrustworthiness

disciplinary_grounds.description: Adjudged mentally incompetent by a court of competent jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Been adjudged mentally incompetent by a court of competent jurisdiction, within or outside this state.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Become unable to practice with reasonable skill and safety to patients by reason of illness, substance use, or mental/physical condition
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Become unable to practice pursuant to this chapter with reasonable skill and safety to patients by reason of illness or use of alcohol, drugs, narcotics, chemicals, or any other type of material, or as a result of any mental or physical condition.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Cheated on or attempted to subvert a board examination
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Cheated on or attempted to subvert an examination by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committed an act of sexual abuse, misconduct, or exploitation of a patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committed an act of sexual abuse, misconduct, or exploitation of a patient including guardians and parents of minors

disciplinary_grounds.description: Pleaded guilty to or been found guilty by a court of committing a sexual assault on a patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Pleaded guilty to committing a sexual assault on a patient; or Been found guilty by a court of law of committing a sexual assault on a patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Mistreated or abandoned a patient or their records
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Mistreated or abandoned a patient or his or her records

disciplinary_grounds.description: Entered into conduct which discredits the profession
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Entered into conduct which discredits the profession

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to furnish records to the board in response to a subpoena or failed to answer renewal questions
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failed to furnish records, including, but not limited to, medical records, to the board in response to a subpoena or failed to answer questions on the renewal of the license, certificate, or permit

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to maintain appropriate medical or other records as required by board rule
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failed to maintain appropriate medical or other records as required by board rule

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to follow generally accepted infection control procedures or OSHA standards
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failed to follow generally accepted infection control procedures or Occupational Safety and Health Administration standards

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to comply with federal laws and standards relating to the practice of medicine or delivery of health care
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failed to comply with federal laws and standards relating to the practice of medicine or other health care profession regulated under this chapter, the regulations of drugs, the delivery of health care, or other related laws

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to comply with an order for child support
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failed to comply with an order for child support as defined by Code Section 19-11-9.3

disciplinary_grounds.description: Been a physician employed by one the physician delegates to, enters a protocol with, or is responsible for supervising (with limited exceptions)
disciplinary_grounds.quote: been a physician that has been or is employed by one the physician: Delegates medical acts to; Enters a protocol or job description with; or Is responsible for supervising.

establishment_regulation_required.quote: On and after July 1, 2013, all pain management clinics shall be licensed by the board and shall biennially renew their license with the board.

definition_quote.value: To practice medicine means to hold oneself out to the public as being engaged in the diagnosis or treatment of disease, defects, or injuries of human beings; or the suggestion, recommendation, or prescribing of any form of treatment for the intended palliation, relief, or cure of any physical, mental, or functional ailment or defect of any person with the intention of receiving therefor, either directly or indirectly, any fee, gift, or compensation whatsoever; or the maintenance of an office for the reception, examination, and treatment of persons suffering from disease, defect, or injury of body or mind; or attaching the title "M.D.," "Oph.," "D.," "Dop.," "Surgeon," "Doctor," "D.O.," "Doctor of Osteopathy," "Allopathic Physician," "Osteopathic Physician," or "Physician," either alone or in connection with other words, or any other words or abbreviations to one's name, indicating that such person is engaged in the treatment or diagnosis of disease, defects, or injuries to human beings
definition_quote.quote: "To practice medicine," "the practice of medicine," or "practicing medicine" means to hold oneself out to the public as being engaged in the diagnosis or treatment of disease, defects, or injuries of human beings; or the suggestion, recommendation, or prescribing of any form of treatment for the intended palliation, relief, or cure of any physical, mental, or functional ailment or defect of any person with the intention of receiving therefor, either directly or indirectly, any fee, gift, or compensation whatsoever

methods_authorized.quote: to hold oneself out to the public as being engaged in the diagnosis or treatment of disease, defects, or injuries of human beings; or the suggestion, recommendation, or prescribing of any form of treatment for the intended palliation, relief, or cure of any physical, mental, or functional ailment or defect of any person

drug_authority.value: Licensed physicians have authority to prescribe controlled substances and dangerous drugs, and may delegate ordering authority to physician assistants and advanced practice registered nurses under approved protocols.
drug_authority.quote: A physician may delegate to a physician assistant, in accordance with a job description, the authority to issue a prescription drug order or orders for any device as defined in Code Section 26-4-5 or to issue any dangerous drug as defined in Code Section 16-13-71 or any Schedule III, IV, or V controlled substance

license_status_types.quote: To establish rules regarding licensure and certification status, including, but not limited to, inactive status, as the board deems appropriate

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Graduates of foreign (non-US, non-Canadian) medical schools approved by the board who graduated after July 1, 1985, must complete three years of ACGME/AOA/board-approved residency, fellowship, or postgraduate training. ECFMG certification or qualifying examination required for certain pathways. Alien applicants (other than Canadian graduates) must have resided in the US for one year.
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: Persons who graduated after July 1, 1985, from medical schools or osteopathic medical schools which are not approved by the board must complete three years of residency, fellowship, or other postgraduate medical training that is approved by the Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education (ACGME), the American Osteopathic Association (AOA), or the board to be eligible for a license to practice medicine in this state.

postgraduate_training_years_required.quote: Graduates of board approved medical schools or osteopathic medical schools and persons who graduated on or before July 1, 1985, from medical schools or osteopathic medical schools which are not approved by the board must complete one year of a postgraduate residency training program.

pain_management_education_required.quote: The board may establish minimum standards of continuing medical education for all physicians owning a pain management clinic.

pain_management_clinic_registration_requ.quote: On and after July 1, 2013, all pain management clinics shall be licensed by the board and shall biennially renew their license with the board.

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: A telemedicine licensee is limited to the practice of telemedicine and shall not be authorized to engage in the practice of medicine while physically present in this state with respect to a patient also physically present in this state, except in response to an emergency.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: A person issued a telemedicine license pursuant to this Code section shall not be authorized to engage in the practice of medicine while physically present in this state with respect to a patient also physically present in this state; provided, however, that this subsection shall not apply to consultation provided in response to an emergency.

telemedicine_license_available.quote: The board shall be authorized to issue telemedicine licenses to physicians who are licensed in other states but not licensed in this state to engage in the practice of medicine through telemedicine

interstate_medical_licensure_compact_mem.quote: The Interstate Medical Licensure Compact is enacted into law and entered into by the State of Georgia with any and all other states legally joining therein

physician_assistant_supervision_model.quote: "Job description" means a document, signed by the primary supervising physician and the physician assistant, in which the primary supervising physician delegates to that physician assistant authority to perform certain medical acts

physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.value: Physician assistants may be delegated authority to prescribe dangerous drugs and Schedule III, IV, or V controlled substances. Schedule I and II controlled substances are prohibited except hydrocodone/oxycodone in emergency situations (5-day initial prescription only, for patients 18+, with at least 1 year post-licensure experience and specific authorization in job description).
physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.quote: a physician may delegate to a physician assistant, in accordance with a job description, the authority to issue a prescription drug order or orders for any device as defined in Code Section 26-4-5 or to issue any dangerous drug as defined in Code Section 16-13-71, hydrocodone, oxycodone, or compounds thereof in accordance with subparagraph (B) of this paragraph, or any Schedule III, IV, or V controlled substance

max_physician_assistants_per_supervising.quote: No primary supervising physician shall enter into a job description with a physician assistant pursuant to this Code section or a nurse protocol agreement with an advanced practice registered nurse pursuant to Code Section 43-34-25 with more than the combined equivalent of eight physician assistants or advanced practice registered nurses or supervise more than the combined equivalent of eight physician assistants or advanced practice registered nurses at a time

malpractice_reporting_required.quote: Every licensee, certificate holder, or permit holder shall notify the board of any settlement or judgment, excluding any low payment under a high/low agreement, involving the licensee, certificate holder, or permit holder involving an action for medical malpractice.

impaired_physician_program_authorized.quote: The board shall be authorized to conduct a professional health program to provide monitoring and rehabilitation of impaired health care professionals in this state.

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: In enforcing this paragraph the board may, upon reasonable grounds, require a licensee, certificate holder, permit holder, or applicant to submit to a mental or physical examination by physicians designated by the board.

administrative_medicine_license_availabl.quote: "Administrative medicine license" means a license issued pursuant to this Code section to engage in the practice of administrative medicine.

sexual_misconduct_training_required.quote: On and after January 1, 2022, all physicians shall be required to receive one-time education and training, for a minimum of two hours, regarding professional boundaries and physician sexual misconduct.
